verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a dedicated conversion/quote API (Transfers v3 replacing the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet conversion) plus live quotes generated per payment and rules linking fiat accounts to crypto addresses for on/off-ramp automation, indicating conversion is a core, documented API capability. However, the evidence does not show explicit documentation of conversion fee schedules or settlement-time guarantees beyond a generic partner markup-fee mention. Missing for 10: documented conversion fee/rate schedules, explicit settlement-time SLAs, and independent corroboration of quote accuracy/execution reliability.
